name: prompt-builder
description: Brief Claude properly before it starts. Turns a rough ask into a complete, context-rich prompt — through a short targeted interview or by upgrading a draft — then offers to run it immediately. Flags standing rules that belong in CLAUDE.md or memory so future prompts stay short. Also ships the toolkit's ask-first routing behavior as a SessionStart hook, so Claude asks which skill you want when a request overlaps several — no setup required.
